Customer Care

Customer Care Policy

Help with your ItsAI service, from technical questions to subscriptions and billing.

This page explains how to request assistance and where to find information about cancellations, refund enquiries and complaints.

Contacting Customer CareSubscriptions & cancellationsBilling enquiries & refund requestsComplaintsPersonal informationService provider

Contacting Customer Care

For help with ItsAI, use our Contact Us form. You can contact us about access problems, presentation downloads, subscriptions, billing questions or feedback.

Please include the email address and mobile number associated with your service, your country and mobile operator, and a description of the issue. For a technical problem, include the device, browser and any error message. Do not send passwords or full payment-card details.

Subscriptions & cancellations

You can cancel through the “Unsubscribe” link in your personal menu. Cancellation stops automatic renewal, with access continuing until the end of the current subscription period.

If you cannot access your account or need help cancelling, use Contact Us and select “Subscription / Unsubscription Issues”.

Billing enquiries & refund requests

For an unrecognised charge or a refund enquiry, contact support with the date and amount of the charge, your country, mobile operator and the mobile number associated with the subscription. You may attach a relevant receipt or screenshot after hiding unrelated personal information.

Complaints

To raise a complaint, describe what happened, when it happened and the outcome you are requesting. If you have already contacted support, include the previous correspondence or case reference.

Personal information

Only include information needed to identify your subscription and investigate your request. Hide unrelated account details in attachments.
